basic_info.description: Welcome to your urban oasis in the heart of San Francisco! This stunning 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom townhouse-style condo is located in the sought-after Opera Plaza community, offering both luxury and convenience. This two-level residence boasts 1,030 sq. ft. of bright and airy living space with an open-concept design. A charming balcony off the primary bedroom and an enclosed patio on the main level provide tranquil retreats. Features a private bath, generous closet space, and direct access to a serene common walkway. In unit washer and dryer, 24-hour security & concierge service, Heated swimming pool & spa. On-site restaurants, cafés, and retail shops. Just minutes from Hayes Valley, downtown, and public transit, you're in the center of it all!
